detail: Using the live session transcript captures real dogfooding behavior with the updated instructions. Adding it as a third 'good' fixture provides an A/B comparison: session-good-workflow (pre-fix) vs this session (post-fix). The scrub script already handles in-progress JSONL files correctly since it processes line-by-line. Three fixtures (2 good, 1 poor) give better signal than two.
summary: Use current live session as third eval fixture — captures post-instruction-fix behavior for A/B comparison
